resources.string: Earbud and case battery, plus listening mode buttons

No paired devices found. Pair your Buds in Bluetooth settings first.
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Buds Battery

Tips:
• Battery updates whenever your Buds report it (usually on connect and every few percent).
• If it won't connect, the Galaxy Wearable app may be holding the connection. Try force-stopping it, then tap Connect.
• Tapping the widget refreshes the connection.
